metadata.title: Property $(T)$ and nonlinearity of mapping class group quotients
metadata.abstract: We give a general method for proving Kazhdan's property $(T)$ for quotients $G/K_{[c+1]}$, where $G$ is countable, $K$ is a normal subgroup and $K_{[j]}$ denotes its lower central series. The method combines an affine realization of $G/[K,K]$, a contraction argument, and permanence for nilpotent normal subgroups. We apply it to the Torelli lower-central quotients $\mathrm{Mod}(\Sigma_g)/(\mathcal{T}_g)_{[c+1]}$ for $g\ge3$ and show that they have property $(T)$ for every $c\ge1$. We also prove property $(T)$ for $\mathrm{Aut}(F_3)/(\mathrm{IA}_3)_{[c+1]}$ for every $c\ge1$, relating these groups to the tame nilpotent images studied by Lubotzky and Pak. For the Torelli lower-central quotients with $g\ge3$ and $c\ge2$, every finite-dimensional complex representation has infinite kernel, and these quotients are not linear over any field.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 作者给出正规子群下中心列商具有 Kazhdan 性质 (T) 的一般方法，应用于映射类群的 Torelli 下中心列商及 Aut(F₃) 的相应商，并证明指定 Torelli 商的非线性。
techniques: 幂零正规子群的性质传递
analysis.breakthrough: 统一得到全部指定阶数的性质 (T)，并排除一族商群的有限维忠实线性表示。
analysis.limitations: 属数 g≥3、商的阶数及有限维复表示无限核结论的适用范围不同，须精读。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 群作用刚性与曲面拓扑交叉强，一般方法可能有较广复用。
